name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up for a hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, one foot planted.
Extend the other leg straight out as a counterbalance.
Drive through the planted heel, lifting the hips to full extension.
Lower with control. Unilateral glute strength with high carryover to sprinting.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: An intermediate bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the glutes. Single-Leg Hip Thrust builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
